patterns.name: Boom bap
patterns.desc: Kick on 1, the 'a' of 2 and the 'and' of 3; a hard snare cracks on 2 and 4 with a ghost note on the last sixteenth pulling into the next bar. Swung eighth-note hats give the head-nod bounce.
patterns.prompt: classic 90s boom bap drum groove, dusty punchy kick, cracking snare on 2 and 4, swung eighth-note hi-hats, head-nodding at 90 BPM

patterns.name: Lo-fi swing
patterns.desc: A lazy, behind-the-beat groove: kick on 1, the 'a' of 2 and the 'e' of 3, a soft snare on 2 and 4, eighth hats with ghosted sixteenths. Heavy swing drags every offbeat late, which is the whole charm.
patterns.prompt: lazy lo-fi hip-hop drums with heavy swing, soft dusty kick, muted snare on 2 and 4, loose ghosted hi-hats and a quiet shaker, relaxed 80 BPM

patterns.name: Trap (with hat rolls)
patterns.desc: One bar in 32nd notes on a 140 BPM grid so the rolls can be written. The clap lands only on beat 3 for the half-time feel; kick and 808 hit 1 and push just before and after the clap; eighth-note hats break into sixteenths and a 32nd-note roll at the end of the bar.
patterns.prompt: hard trap drums at 140 BPM in half-time, booming TR-808 kick and gliding 808 bass, sharp clap on beat 3, rattling hi-hats with fast 32nd-note rolls

patterns.name: UK drill
patterns.desc: Half-time at 140: the main snare sits on beat 3 and a late second snare on the 'and' of 4 gives drill its off-kilter skip. Hats move in 3-3-2 groupings, and the sparse kick leaves room for 808 notes that slide between pitches.
patterns.prompt: UK drill drums at 142 BPM, half-time snare on beat 3 with a late skippy second snare, syncopated 3-3-2 hi-hats, dark sliding 808 bass glides

patterns.name: NY drill
patterns.desc: The New York take on drill: snare on beat 3 with a ghosted pickup on the last sixteenth, a bouncier kick that doubles on the 'a' of 1, and a busy 808 line that slides on almost every hit. Hats skip in syncopated bursts and finish with a fast roll.
patterns.prompt: New York drill drums at 144 BPM, aggressive half-time snare on beat 3, bouncing kick, heavily distorted sliding 808 glides, skippy hi-hats with triplet rolls

patterns.name: Drift phonk cowbell
patterns.desc: Kick on 1, 3 and the 'and' of 3, a hard clap on 2 and 4 for drive, and the star of the show: a distorted TR-808 cowbell melody in a syncopated 3-3-2 rhythm, twice per bar. Hats roll into the next bar.
patterns.prompt: drift phonk drums at 130 BPM, punchy distorted kick, hard clap on 2 and 4, loud overdriven TR-808 cowbell melody in a syncopated 3-3-2 rhythm

patterns.name: G-funk bounce
patterns.desc: Laid-back West Coast bounce: kick on 1, the 'a' of 2, the 'and' of 3 and the 'e' of 4; snare and clap stacked on 2 and 4; sixteenth hats with soft in-between strokes and an open hat on the 'and' of 4. Light swing keeps it rolling.
patterns.prompt: laid-back G-funk drums at 94 BPM, rolling TR-808 kick, snare and clap stacked on 2 and 4, swung sixteenth hi-hats, open hat lifting the end of each bar

patterns.name: Four-on-the-floor house
patterns.desc: The foundation of dance music: kick on every quarter note, clap on 2 and 4, an open hat on every offbeat 'and' for the 'tss' lift, and a sixteenth shaker for motion.
patterns.prompt: classic four-on-the-floor house groove at 124 BPM, punchy TR-909 kick on every beat, clap on 2 and 4, open hi-hat on the offbeats, shuffling shaker

patterns.name: Deep house
patterns.desc: A softer, rounder kick on all four beats, a gentle clap on 2 and 4, closed hats on the offbeats, a swung shaker, and rim clicks on the 'a' of 1, the 'and' of 2 and the 'e' of 4 for a warm, rolling feel.
patterns.prompt: warm deep house groove at 120 BPM, soft round four-on-the-floor kick, gentle clap on 2 and 4, offbeat closed hats, swung shaker and syncopated rimshots

patterns.name: Techno
patterns.desc: A relentless kick on every beat, driving sixteenth closed hats that make way for accented open hats on every offbeat, and a percussion stab on the 'a' of 1 and the 'and' of 2 (repeated in the second half) that keeps the loop hypnotic.
patterns.prompt: driving warehouse techno groove at 132 BPM, pounding four-on-the-floor kick, relentless sixteenth hi-hats, offbeat open hats, hypnotic syncopated percussion

patterns.name: UK garage 2-step
patterns.desc: The 2-step skip: kick on 1 and the 'and' of 3, skipping beat 3 itself, snare on 2 and 4, shuffling hats with ghosted sixteenths, and syncopated rimshots. Heavy swing gives garage its rolling, skippy bounce.
patterns.prompt: UK garage 2-step drums at 134 BPM, skippy kick on 1 and the and of 3, crisp snare on 2 and 4, heavily swung shuffling hi-hats, syncopated rimshots

patterns.name: Breakbeat
patterns.desc: A syncopated funk break: kick on 1, the 'a' of 1 and the 'and' of 3, hard snare on 2 and 4 with ghost notes on the 'e' of 3 and the 'and' of 4, and eighth-note hats. Pushed to 130 BPM it becomes big beat and breaks.
patterns.prompt: funky chopped breakbeat drums at 130 BPM, syncopated punchy kick, crisp snare on 2 and 4 with ghost notes, driving eighth-note hats, big-beat energy

patterns.name: Jungle (Amen-style)
patterns.desc: The classic 1960s funk break (Amen-style) sped up: kick on 1 and its 'and', then a double on the 'and' and 'a' of 3; snares on 2 and 4 with ghosts on the 'a' of 2, the 'e' of 3 and the 'a' of 4; ride eighths on top. Jungle chops and rearranges it at 160 plus.
patterns.prompt: frantic jungle drums at 170 BPM, chopped and rearranged vintage funk breakbeat, rapid ghost-noted snares, ride cymbal eighths, rolling over deep sub bass

patterns.name: Drum and bass two-step
patterns.desc: Drum and bass in its simplest form: kick on 1 and the 'and' of 3, snare on 2 and 4, so the groove feels half-time at 87 while the hats race at 174. The gap after the second kick is where the bassline rolls.
patterns.prompt: rolling drum and bass two-step at 174 BPM, tight kick on 1 and the and of 3, sharp snare on 2 and 4, fast shuffling hi-hats, deep rolling bass

patterns.name: Dubstep half-time
patterns.desc: Half-time at 140: the snare lands only on beat 3, so the groove feels like 70 while the hats move at full speed. The kick on 1 and the 'e' of 4 leaves huge gaps for the wobble bass.
patterns.prompt: heavy dubstep half-time drums at 140 BPM, booming kick, massive snare on beat 3 with big reverb, crisp hi-hats, wide space for growling wobble bass

patterns.name: Reggaeton dembow
patterns.desc: The dembow: kick on every beat, snare on the 'a' of 1, the 'and' of 2, the 'a' of 3 and the 'and' of 4. That 3-3-2 snare against the straight kick is the instantly recognizable reggaeton bounce.
patterns.prompt: reggaeton dembow groove at 95 BPM, steady kick on every beat, syncopated snare in the classic dembow 3-3-2 pattern, crisp hi-hats, deep 808 bass

patterns.name: Afrobeats
patterns.desc: Kick on 1, the 'and' of 2, 3 and the 'and' of 4 for a lilting push; a soft clap on 2 and 4; rimshots tracing a 3-2 clave; and a busy sixteenth shaker. Light swing makes it sway rather than shuffle.
patterns.prompt: afrobeats groove at 106 BPM, lilting syncopated kick, soft clap on 2 and 4, rimshots on a 3-2 clave, busy shaker, talking drum and conga accents

patterns.name: Amapiano log drum
patterns.desc: A soft kick on every beat under a swung shaker and gentle claps on 2 and 4, while the log drum, a pitched percussive bass, hits the 'a' of 1, the 'and' of 2, the 'and' of 3, beat 4 and its 'and'.
patterns.prompt: amapiano groove at 112 BPM, soft four-on-the-floor kick, swung shakers, gentle claps and rimshots, deep syncopated log drum bass hits

patterns.name: Jersey club
patterns.desc: The jersey bounce: five kicks per bar on 1, 2, 3, the 'a' of 3 and the 'and' of 4, so the last three tumble into the next bar. Claps on 2 and 4 and offbeat sample stabs (bed squeaks, vocal chops) complete it.
patterns.prompt: jersey club drums at 140 BPM, bouncing five-kick pattern with tumbling kicks at the end of each bar, sharp claps, offbeat squeaky sample stabs

patterns.name: Miami bass
patterns.desc: Electro-rooted booty bass: long TR-808 kick booms on 1, the 'and' of 2 and the 'and' of 3, claps on 2 and 4, machine-gun sixteenth hats and a syncopated 808 cowbell. Tuned low and long, the kick doubles as the bassline.
patterns.prompt: Miami bass drums at 130 BPM, long booming TR-808 kick that doubles as bass, snappy claps on 2 and 4, rapid sixteenth hi-hats, syncopated 808 cowbell

patterns.name: Rock backbeat
patterns.desc: Rock's backbone: kick on 1, 3 and the 'and' of 3, snare cracking on 2 and 4, straight eighth-note hats, and a crash on the downbeat to mark each new phrase.
patterns.prompt: driving rock backbeat at 120 BPM, live acoustic drum kit, solid kick on 1 and 3, cracking snare on 2 and 4, straight eighth-note hi-hats, crash on the downbeat

patterns.name: Punk skate beat
patterns.desc: The skate-punk beat: kick on every quarter note and snare on every 'and' in between, an oom-pah alternation that sounds like a sprint at 180 BPM. Washy open hats ride straight eighths on top.
patterns.prompt: fast punk skate beat at 180 BPM, kick on every beat and snare on every offbeat, bashing open hi-hats and crash cymbals, raw garage energy

patterns.name: Funk with ghost notes
patterns.desc: Syncopated kick on 1, the 'and' of 1, the 'and' of 3 and the 'e' of 4; a strong backbeat on 2 and 4 surrounded by soft ghost-note snares that fill the sixteenth grid; sixteenth hats that open on the 'and' of 4.
patterns.prompt: tight 70s funk drums at 104 BPM, syncopated kick, fat snare backbeat on 2 and 4 surrounded by quiet ghost notes, crisp sixteenth hi-hats with an open-hat lift

patterns.name: Disco
patterns.desc: Four-on-the-floor kick, snare on 2 and 4, and the defining open hi-hat on every offbeat 'and', with closed sixteenths filling the gaps around it. That offbeat 'tss' is what gets people dancing.
patterns.prompt: classic disco drums at 120 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, snare on 2 and 4, sizzling open hi-hat on every offbeat, busy sixteenth closed hats, live and groovy

patterns.name: Motown stomp
patterns.desc: The 1960s soul stomp: snare on all four beats with the backbeat accented, tambourine shaking eighths and slapping 2 and 4, and a simple kick on 1, the 'and' of 2 and 3. Everything leans forward for dancing.
patterns.prompt: 1960s soul drums at 124 BPM, snare hitting all four beats, bright tambourine slapping the backbeat, simple driving kick, warm live room, joyful forward stomp

patterns.name: Bossa nova
patterns.desc: Two bars written in eighth notes: the soft kick plays a dotted-quarter-plus-eighth heartbeat (1, the 'and' of 2, 3, the 'and' of 4), the cross-stick traces the bossa clave, the foot hat ticks 2 and 4, and brushes or ride play straight eighths.
patterns.prompt: gentle bossa nova groove at 130 BPM, soft brushed drums, cross-stick rim clicks tracing the bossa clave, quiet heartbeat kick, straight eighth-note ride

patterns.name: Reggae one drop
patterns.desc: The one drop: beat 1 is left empty and the kick and cross-stick land together on beat 3, while swung hats keep time. The missing downbeat gives roots reggae its floating, laid-back pull.
patterns.prompt: roots reggae one-drop drums at 74 BPM, kick and cross-stick rimshot together on beat 3, an open, empty downbeat, swung hi-hats, deep dub bass

patterns.name: 12/8 blues shuffle
patterns.desc: Each beat is split into three triplet eighths. The ride plays the first and third of every triplet, the long-short shuffle, with kick on 1 and 3 and a snare backbeat on 2 and 4. Count it in dotted quarters, roughly 70 to 90 BPM.
patterns.prompt: slow 12/8 blues shuffle at 80 BPM, lazy triplet-feel ride cymbal, kick on 1 and 3, fat snare backbeat on 2 and 4, smoky live club drums

patterns.name: 6/8 ballad
patterns.desc: One bar of 6/8 in sixteenths: six eighth-note hats, kick on 1 with a pickup on the sixth eighth, and a rim or soft snare on 4, the second big beat. Felt as two slow sways per bar, about 55 to 65 dotted-quarter BPM.
patterns.prompt: slow 6/8 ballad groove, two gentle sways per bar at about 60 BPM, soft kick on 1, rimshot on 4, flowing eighth-note hi-hats, brushed and tender

patterns.name: Half-time trap-soul
patterns.desc: Moody R&B in half-time: on a 130 grid the snap-clap lands only on beat 3, so it feels like a slow 65. Kick and long 808 notes hit 1 and the 'a' of 3, and lazy eighth hats end with a small roll into the next bar.
patterns.prompt: moody trap-soul drums in half-time at 130 BPM, finger snaps and soft clap on beat 3, deep long 808 notes, lazy hi-hats with small rolls, late-night R&B
